title: RAG vs Fine-Tuning
description: Two ways to give an AI model new information, and when to pick each.
summary: RAG leaves the model unchanged: for every question it fetches relevant documents and adds them to the prompt, so updating the documents updates the answers. Fine-Tuning trains the model further on examples, changing its weights, which suits a consistent style or format but needs retraining to add new facts. For facts that change often, like a college office's exam dates, start with RAG.
